pair_addr.description: XYK-only: the pair created at settle. CLMM settles report `pool_addr`.

pool_addr.description: OBSERVABILITY: CLMM pool created at settle — `None` for XYK / pre-settle.

position_token_id.description: OBSERVABILITY: position NFT `token_id` minted to the locker at CLMM settle — `None` for XYK / pre-settle.

SinkStatus.description: Sink mutation surface. Transitions are one-shot: `Pending → Settled | Refunded`. Refused exec attempts past terminal states fail with [`crate::error::ContractError::SinkTerminal`].
